lead.description: a measure of agreement between two rankings, on a scale from -1 to +1

overview_sentence: [Spearman's rank correlation coefficient](articles/spearman-s-rank-correlation-coefficient.qmd) measures agreement between two rankings.

self_checks.title: Mild disagreement
self_checks.prompt: Rank differences are 0, 0, -1, and 1, so the squared differences sum to 2, and n = 4. What is the coefficient?

self_checks.title: Complete reversal
self_checks.prompt: The squared rank differences for a complete reversal of four ranks sum to 20. What is the coefficient?
